title: Comeback Adjustment to the Same-Visit Courtesy (Workmanship Warranties)
content:
**Rule.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, the same-visit courtesy sum on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty, with everything added into it, is adjusted for the remedy attempts completed on the coverage less than the comeback-window months, 12 whole calendar months, before the courtesy date, network reworks and outside-shop repairs alike and whatever their result:

| Remedy attempts completed on the coverage in the window | Same-visit courtesy sum |
|---|---|
| two or more | multiplied by the repeated-comeback multiplier of 1.4 and rounded up to the whole dollar |
| exactly one | multiplied by the single-comeback multiplier of 1.15 and rounded to the cent |
| none | stays as figured |

The adjustment acts on the same-visit courtesy sum before it is limited to the plan's goodwill authority per charge.

## What counts

- Completed network reworks and completed outside-shop repairs on the coverage, resolved or not resolved alike.
- Only completions less than 12 whole calendar months before the courtesy date.

## Worked figures (hypothetical same-visit courtesy sum of USD 18.60)

| Completions in the window | Calculation | Adjusted sum |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | USD 18.60 multiplied by 1.4 is USD 26.04, rounded up to the whole dollar | USD 27.00 |
| 1 | USD 18.60 multiplied by 1.15 is USD 21.39 | USD 21.39 |
| 0 | unchanged | USD 18.60 |
